about_short_description.short_description: Andon Labs is an AI safety and research startup that focuses on developing benchmarks, evaluations, and real-world deployments.

product.name: Safe Autonomous Organization (SAO) Deployments
product.description: Real-world deployment of AI agents with tools, money, and operational authority to run businesses and organizations while researchers evaluate behavior and apply safety controls.

product.name: Vending-Bench
product.description: A benchmark for evaluating how AI agents manage a simulated vending-machine business over long time horizons, including purchasing, pricing, customer service, and financial decisions.

product.name: Vending-Bench 2 and Vending-Bench Arena
product.description: An expanded vending-business evaluation suite that measures long-horizon agent performance and multi-agent competition, including negotiation, adversarial suppliers, customer complaints, and strategic behavior.

product.name: Drone-Bench
product.description: A benchmark measuring how well AI agents write code for autonomous drones operating in simulated real-world environments, including evaluation of cheating and attempts to access protected test information.

product.name: Blueprint-Bench
product.description: A spatial-intelligence benchmark that tests whether AI models can convert photographs of indoor spaces into accurate two-dimensional floor plans.

product.name: Butter-Bench
product.description: A robotics benchmark for evaluating whether language models can control robots to perform practical household manipulation and delivery tasks.
